control.name: CONTROL: the escape check is removed, so every recorded link is accepted

mutations.name: escape check: an absolute target is accepted
escape check: a non-portable target (backslash or drive prefix) is accepted
escape check: a .. above the snapshot root is clamped at the root instead of refused
escape check: a chain is not followed, so only the first link's own target is judged
escape check: a link reached through the chain may be absolute
escape check: a loop or over-long chain is accepted
escape check: the hop bound is off by one
escape check: the target is resolved lexically, ignoring links on its path
submodule: a gitlink entry is skipped instead of refused
mutations.old:
default:
			return fail("delivery snapshot contains a symlink or submodule: " + entry.Path)

mutations.name: not followed: the extracted link is left in place, so readers pass through it
in-tree link: every symlink is refused again (the original over-refusal)
mutations.new:
case "120000":
			return fail("delivery snapshot contains a symlink or submodule: " + entry.Path)
